column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 2 Golgotha prison scene / Prague turns
# Scoped to Prague's direct self-identified warden dialogue. No manual wrapping.

column2: Just as one would expect of people brazen enough to commit the $$七つの大罪$$...
such thoroughly wicked criminals, with no morals at all!
To make such a racket in the prison where I, $$プラハ$$, serve as $$獄長$$...
You've got nerve, haven't you?!
Kill you, you say?! Hmph! Compared with being killed...
being forced to keep on living brings far more suffering!
Besides, even at this very moment, millions across the $$世界$$ are dying like scraps in famine and war...
A human life...
least of all you $$奴隷$$ with white $$羽$$...
are not even worth a single piece of bread...
Do you think a death sentence, such a light punishment...
could possibly be enough for you?!
And now $$愛$$, too...?!
Where in $$この世$$ do you think you will find such things?!
Worst of all, you made your own $$飼い主$$ believe in the greatest invisible hypocrisy—$$愛$$...
Your $$罪$$ of driving them down the path to ruin deserves ten thousand deaths!
Make certain they do not cause any more trouble!!
